hints.title: Hierarchical Multipliers
hints.text: Parentheses group sub-formulas, and any following digits multiply the counts of all chemical elements inside that group.

hints.title: Nested Scope Management
hints.text: Push a new scope dictionary onto a collection whenever an open parenthesis is encountered.

hints.title: Pop and Multiply
hints.text: On encountering a closing parenthesis, parse the subsequent multiplier count, pop the top scope map, multiply all its counts by the multiplier, and merge them into the parent scope map.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Scope hierarchy tracking element counts multiplied by enclosing parentheses scopes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flattening formulas with regex cannot handle arbitrarily deeply nested parentheses multipliers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scoped frequency maps naturally propagate multipliers upward in linear to quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly parse multi-character element names (upper followed by lower) and default count 1.
